acceptance.check: INV-AC-1-OLS-QUALIFIER (qualifier at per the routing map, severity refuse): An OLS figure without {missing} cannot be acted on.

INV-AC-2-DECLARED-DISTANCE (qualifier at per the routing map, severity refuse): A declared distance without {missing} cannot be acted on: a temporary table and a permanent one are different distances on the same runway, and 13L is not 31R.

INV-AC-3-SAFETY-AREA (qualifier at per the routing map, severity refuse): A safety-area dimension without {missing} cannot be acted on — the required length is a function of the category and the code.
INV-AC-4-PCN-QUALIFIER (qualifier at per the routing map, severity refuse): A PCN without {missing} is a number that cannot be compared to any ACN.

INV-AC-5-UNITS-DATUM (unit_discipline at per the routing map, severity refuse): Units and datum, stated and not mixed: metres against feet, WGS-84 against a local grid, or magnetic against true are all the same defect.
INV-AC-6-PROVENANCE (provenance at per the routing map, severity refuse): A figure does not carry across runway, airport or revision — and 'a similar runway' is not this runway.

INV-AC-7-NAVAID-LIVE (currency at per the routing map, severity refuse): NAVAID answer with no current status — the state is UNKNOWN. A siting drawing shows where the aerial is, not whether it is working.
INV-AC-8-NOTAM-CURRENCY (currency at per the routing map, severity refuse): A declared distance is only current until the next NOTAM or AIRAC issue — currency here is a cycle, not a clock.
INV-AC-9-PHASING-LIVE (currency at per the routing map, severity refuse): Phasing plan revision unverifiable — a works figure without the approved revision it belongs to cannot be acted on.
INV-AC-13-PCN-CURRENCY (currency at per the routing map, severity refuse): A PCN is superseded by the next pavement evaluation or an overlay — the number survives the pavement it described.
INV-AC-14-OLS-CURRENCY (currency at per the routing map, severity refuse): An OLS assessment is superseded the moment an obstacle is erected or works commence inside the surface.

INV-AC-10-AUTHORITY (authority at per the routing map, severity refuse): This figure comes from the approved table, the safeguarding assessment or the pavement evaluation. A design drawing or a site record is a different class of thing, and scaling off a drawing is the classic substitution.
INV-AC-11-GROUNDING (grounding at per the routing map, severity refuse): {quantity} = {value} is not grounded: no source was supplied for it. This kit never asserts a value of its own.
INV-AC-12-SCOPE-REFUSAL (scope at per the routing map, severity refuse): Operational-authority questions are refused before retrieval.

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Declarative airport construction reasoning kit on the shared reasoning layer. 14 invariants declared in app/blocks/airport_construction/invariants.yaml across the kinds the portable spec defines (grounding, qualifier, unit_discipline, authority, provenance, currency, scope, derivation, band) and the five hooks (H0 pre-retrieval, H1 ranking, H2 tool-time, H3 answer-time, H4 export-time). Vocabulary in app/blocks/airport_construction/manifest.yaml. Scope refusals classify BEFORE retrieval. Fail closed: a kit that does not parse is DISABLED and refuses every statement rather than passing them through with no invariants. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN, so every declared figure value is null and the block refuses rather than inventing one (app/blocks/airport_construction/KNOWN_GAPS.md). Measured by tests/blocks/test_reasoning_kits.py.

inputs.description: the operator question, classified at H0 BEFORE any retrieval
inputs.name: question

inputs.description: figures to gate: quantity, value, unit, origin, source_id, source_class, revision, qualifiers, claim_class, derivations, conditions, steps, bounds, asked_about, span, text
inputs.name: figures

inputs.description: state records by provider name, each {as_of: <epoch>}; an absent provider yields UNKNOWN, never a design-basis fallback
inputs.name: state

inputs.description: events that have happened, matched against the kit's staleness_triggers
inputs.name: events

inputs.description: subset of H0..H4 to run; all five by default, because a partial sweep is a silent coverage gap
inputs.name: hooks

name: airport_construction_kit

outputs.description: pass | annotated | flagged | refused, with findings, blocked_reason, hooks_run, retrieval_permitted, interview_status, unfilled_figures, unmeasured_invariants, ships and kit_disabled
outputs.name: verdict
